items.name: The Premature Closer
items.note: options resolve tensions the passage left open; punishes readers who crave closure

items.name: The Scope Inflater
items.note: local claims globalized; paragraph-level truths presented as passage-level theses

items.name: The Time Traveler
items.note: correct content attributed to the wrong stage — early framings presented as final views

items.name: The Sympathetic Import
items.note: plausible frameworks the passage never used; punishes outside knowledge

items.name: The Half-Truth Ledger
items.note: accurate for one strand of the argument, silent about the other

items.name: The Inversion Artist
items.note: causal and priority reversals; effect as cause, evidence as conclusion

items.name: The Tone Deaf
items.note: content-right, stance-wrong; attributes advocacy where there is analysis

items.name: The Vocabulary Magnet
items.note: recycles the passage's most memorable phrases in structurally wrong roles

items.name: The Reasonable Extremist
items.note: moderate wording concealing logically extreme content

items.name: The Straw Vendor
items.note: attributes the weaker version of positions the passage steelmanned

items.name: The Category Slipper
items.note: swaps claim types: empirical/normative, descriptive/definitional, is/ought

items.name: The Consensus Peddler
items.note: what an educated reader already believes, independent of this passage

items.name: The Symmetry Faker
items.note: treats asymmetric relations as mutual; 'each shapes the other' where only one does

items.name: The Level Confuser
items.note: confuses the author's view with views the author reports

items.name: The Necessary/Sufficient Swapper
items.note: conditions promoted or demoted; enabling factors as guarantees

items.name: The Example Promoter
items.note: elevates an illustrative example into load-bearing evidence

items.name: The Missing Link
items.note: valid-sounding inference that skips the passage's actual bridge

items.name: The Overqualifier
items.note: adds hedges the passage doesn't license; sounds safe, is wrong — breaks the 'pick the moderate one' heuristic

items.name: The Adjacent Answer
items.note: the correct answer to the neighboring, unasked question

items.name: The Terminological Twin
items.note: near-synonyms whose technical meanings diverge exactly where it matters
